content: Melvin-Koushki quotes the R. Anjām, in a footnote, as saying that recently a number of locks securing the veils over the quranic grandeur have been opened through the 'moon-splitting writings' of Sayyid Akhlāṭī (arqām-i aqmār inshiqāq-i sayyidī), so that whoever can comprehend them may join those who understand the language of the new generation (naw-khāstagān-i zamān).
